title: What a slice with no recorded status reads as in slices[]
body:
**Chose:** a slice entry whose `status` is missing from the board serializes as `"pending"`, so every `slices[].status` is one of the four values.
**Over:** passing the missing status through as `null`.
**Because:** the field promises one of `pending`, `building`, `done`, `blocked`, and a slice with no status recorded has not started.
**Undo:** drop the `unwrap_or_else` in `run_json` (`src/cli/status.rs`) and make `SliceJson.status` an `Option`.
